summary: Implemented the API security baseline with Helmet headers, exact-origin CORS, bounded JSON and URL-encoded bodies, in-memory rate limiting with health/readiness probe exemptions, unsafe-input sanitization, an explicit trust-proxy policy, and redacted security error envelopes. Integrated the middleware without adding product routes; /health and /ready remain unchanged.
